meta.name: mcp-client
meta.description: Universal MCP client for connecting to any MCP server with progressive disclosure. Wraps MCP servers as skills to avoid context window bloat from tool definitions. Use when interacting with external MCP servers (Zapier, Sequential Thinking, GitHub, filesystem, etc.), listing available tools, or executing MCP tool calls. Triggers on requests like "connect to Zapier", "use MCP server", "list MCP tools", "call Zapier action", "use sequential thinking", or any MCP server interaction.

copy.tagline: 连接任意 MCP 服务器并调用其工具
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过 MCP 协议与各种外部服务交互。
